what: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
title: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
text: Bayesian ancestral reconstruction protein language-model embeddings. ancemb treats embedding produced protein language model (pLM) set continuous traits evolving along phylogeny. reconstructs ancestral embeddings internal nodes Brownian Motion (BM) Ornstein–Uhlenbeck (OU) processes, fitted pre-compiled Stan models instantiate package.

title: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
text: Protein language models compress sequence high-dimensional vector encodes structure function. natural question follows: coordinates behave like phylogenetic traits — , ancestral information stop recoverable embedding geometry? package analysis interface research program decomposes question three testable hypotheses: T1 — trait evolution. Embedding dimensions carry components evolve like continuous traits tree (measurable Blomberg’s K, Pagel’s λ, predictive density held-clades). T2 — trait reconstruction. Phylogenetic models (BM/OU) reconstruct ancestral embeddings better phylogeny-free baselines. T3 — invertibility. Closeness embedding space implies recovery ancestral sequence. Keeping separate deliberate: failure T3 says nothing T2 unless nodes, pools, metrics held fixed — package enforces.

title: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
text: ancemb aims single, tested entry point ancestral embedding inference: data preparation, Stan posterior fits, pure-R reference implementations, optional Python (reticulate) backend embedding arrays, manifest-driven metrics make results comparable across families, representations, models. long-term goal calibrated predictive account embedding evolution — including honest map fails.

what: What has been achieved so far
title: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
text: Validated estimator. Gaussian-trait simulations truth known construction, BM/OU fits recover simulated ancestors. real protein families, Bayesian posterior means agree phytools::fastAnc ML reconstructions cosine ≈ 0.99. Partial phylogenetic signal. Across curated multi-family database (trees + alignments + deposited experimentally resurrected ancestors), ~10.7% embedding dimensions show significant Blomberg’s K multiple-testing correction; ancestral reconstruction beats phylogeny-free baselines shallow families degrades depth. honest limit. Sequence-level recovery ranking candidates embedding space beat classical MAP reconstruction — 340-node benchmark, MAP wins soon real headroom exists (P(d > 0) ≈ 0.19). linear probe recovers ancestral sequence information phylogeny-free baselines, information present embeddings; failing component cosine-ranking/decoder step. Measuring boundary — claiming superiority — contribution. manuscript describing full benchmark preparation.

title: Bayesian Ancestral Reconstruction of Protein Embeddings
text: Prepare small tree observed tip embeddings: Build Stan data list fit Brownian Motion model: Extract ancestral states compare inferred root phytools::fastAnc:
code: library(ancemb) set.seed(42) tree <- ape::rtree(8) tree$edge.length <- tree$edge.length / max(ape::node.depth.edgelength(tree))  z_obs <- matrix(stats::rnorm(8 * 4, sd = 0.5), nrow = 8) rownames(z_obs) <- tree$tip.label stan_data <- prepare_embedding_data(tree, z_obs, obs_sigma = 0.1) fit <- fit_embedding_bm(stan_data, chains = 2, iter_warmup = 300,                         iter_sampling = 300, refresh = 0) #> Running MCMC with 2 sequential chains... #>  #> Chain 1 finished in 0.2 seconds. #> Chain 2 finished in 0.2 seconds. #>  #> Both chains finished successfully. #> Mean chain execution time: 0.2 seconds. #> Total execution time: 0.6 seconds. anc <- extract_ancestral(fit, data = stan_data, tree = tree) root_node <- which(anc$node == stan_data$S + 1)  ml_root <- phytools::fastAnc(tree, z_obs[, 1])[1] cat("ML root (dim 1):", ml_root, "\n") #> ML root (dim 1): 0.5041557 cat("Bayes root mean (dim 1):", anc$mean[root_node, "dim1"], "\n") #> Bayes root mean (dim 1): 0.4241764

title: ancemb 0.1.0
text: First public release alrobles/ancemb. Optional reticulate backend adapter NumPy/NPZ embedding arrays (configure_python_backend(), load_embedding_array()). Trees without branch lengths now fail fast explicit error. Exported pure-R simulation reconstruction references (simulate_*_embedding_r(), reconstruct_ancestral_*_r()).

title: ancemb 0.0.1
text: Initial CRAN-ready package skeleton. Exported prepare_embedding_data(), fit_embedding_bm(), fit_embedding_ou(), extract_ancestral() run_bayesian_comparison(). Added pure-R reference implementations (*_r) BM/OU simulation ancestral reconstruction. Added cross-method testthat tests comparing Stan posterior means phytools::fastAnc pure-R reference. Set pkgdown documentation GitHub Actions R-CMD-check pkgdown deployment.
